about.title: What is Neuromundi?
about.body1: Neuromundi is a global community and marketplace for neurodivergence. We connect families and neurodivergent people with service providers, merchants and inclusive schools, plus a directory of vetted professionals, a store of products and resources, and an academy with courses.
about.body2: Families and neurodivergent people register and use the platform for free. Neuromundi’s purpose is to make quality support easier to find—with real reviews, trustworthy information and safe tools—all in one place.

search.free: Registration is free for families and neurodivergent people.

home.community: We’re not just another directory — we’re a genuine community of support, guidance and companionship, created by patients and families together with specialists and providers focused on neurodevelopment and neurodivergence. This is your space to grow with inclusion.

report.title: Report to the community
report.intro: This space is designed to keep a safe and trustworthy community. Every report is taken seriously and assessed objectively, always guided by the universal ethical principles of honesty and integrity, and by listening to both the reporter and the reported party. Resolution takes 30 days on average.
